Law of Sines Calculator

Solve triangles from AAS, ASA or SSA inputs — with the ambiguous SSA case reporting 0, 1 or 2 solutions.


  




  
  


  

    

      
📖 How to use

      
  1. Pick the known case (AAS, ASA or SSA).
  2. Enter the two angles/sides as labeled.
  3. Press Solve triangle to see every solution with the working.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
What is the ambiguous case?
In SSA, the given side may swing to two positions, giving two different triangles — or none, if it cannot reach the base.
How do you detect zero solutions?
If side a is shorter than the altitude h = b·sin A, it cannot touch the base, so no triangle exists.
Are SSA solutions verified?
Yes — each candidate B is kept only if A + B < 180°, then side c is computed by the law of sines.
